lines.text: The Philistines took the captured ark from Ebenezer to Ashdod and set it beside Dagon's statue.
Dagon fell on his face before the ark two mornings in a row, and the second time his head and hands were broken off.
The LORD's hand struck Ashdod with tumors, so the Philistine rulers decided to move the ark to Gaza.
The LORD's hand was against Gath too, and the ark was then sent to Ekron, where the people cried out.
The Ekronites asked the rulers to send the ark back to Shiloh, and the city's outcry went up to heaven.
